title: THE TREACHEROUS STREAM
style: A storybook illustration in a rich, impasto painterly style, reminiscent of classic fairy tale art, vibrant colors and a soft, diffused atmosphere
negative: no text, no letters, no subtitles, no watermark, consistent character design

characters.name: Mia
characters.bible: Mia, a 9-year-old girl with shoulder-length curly chestnut-brown hair, rosy freckled cheeks and determined, curious hazel eyes, wearing a mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over a white blouse, a rust-red pinafore dress, brown lace-up boots and a small brown leather satchel across her shoulder

characters.name: Whiskers
characters.bible: Whiskers, a sleek, slender cat with a solid jet-black coat and no markings, piercing emerald-green eyes, a thin red collar with a tiny brass bell, and a faint silvery arcane shimmer rippling along his jet-black fur

characters.name: Grandma Nell
characters.bible: Grandma Nell, a kind, softly plump woman of about seventy with silver hair in a loose bun, round gold-rimmed spectacles, rosy cheeks and twinkling grey eyes, wearing a lavender knitted shawl over a long sage-green dress and a white apron

locations.bible: Grandma Nell's cosy thatched cottage, with low dark oak beams, a stone hearth, copper pans, a scrubbed wooden table with a blue-and-white teapot, and a wooden ladder up to a dusty attic with a round window, old trunks and stacks of leather books

a tranquil village of honey-coloured thatched cottages with round green doors and climbing pink roses, scattered across gently rolling green hills, with a winding dirt lane, an old stone well and low dry-stone walls
wide rolling green hills dotted with poppies and white clover, low dry-stone walls, grazing sheep and a lone crooked oak tree with twisted branches, the thatched village small in the distance
a deep rocky valley where a rushing white-and-silver stream foams between boulders, crossed by a line of mossy stepping stones beside the two broken planks of an old wooden bridge
the grassy summit of the highest hill, crowned by a ring of ancient mossy standing stones, with a small round stone door half hidden by ivy set into the hillside at its centre

lines.text: One wrong step, and she will be swept away.
At the bottom of the valley, a stream rushed between the rocks, foaming white and silver.
lines.ar: وفي قاع الوادي، كان جدولٌ يندفع بين الصخور، مُزبِدًا بالأبيض والفضّي.

lines.text: “This looks treacherous,” Mia said quietly. “One wrong step, and we’ll be swept away.”
lines.ar: قالت ميا بهدوء: «هذا يبدو غادرًا. خطوة خاطئة واحدة، وسيجرفنا التيّار».

lines.text: She found a long stick and tested each stone before she trusted it.
lines.ar: وجدت عصًا طويلة، وراحت تختبر كلّ حجر قبل أن تثق به.

lines.text: She lifted Whiskers onto her shoulders, where he clung like a furry scarf.
lines.ar: رفعت ويسكرز على كتفيها، فتشبّث بها كوشاحٍ من الفرو.

lines.text: Halfway across, her boot slipped on the moss. She swayed, her arms whirling, and her knee struck the hard stone.
lines.ar: وفي منتصف الطريق، انزلق حذاؤها على الطحالب. فترنّحت وذراعاها تدوران، وارتطمت ركبتها بالحجر الصلب.

lines.text: Her knee was scraped and stinging, and her eyes filled with tears. But she did not turn back.
lines.ar: كانت ركبتها مخدوشة تلسعها، وامتلأت عيناها بالدموع. لكنّها لم تتراجع.

lines.text: “All right,” Mia sniffed. “We’re resilient, you and I. We fall down, and we get back up.”
lines.ar: قالت ميا وهي تمسح أنفها: «حسنًا، نحن صامدان، أنا وأنت. نسقط، ثمّ ننهض من جديد».

lines.text: Find out what happens next in the full story on our channel.
lines.ar: اكتشف ماذا يحدث بعد ذلك في القصة كاملة على قناتنا.

vocab.meaning: to shine with a faint, gentle, wavering light
vocab.example: A thin line of light began to glimmer across the faded ink.

vocab.meaning: to go somewhere new or a little dangerous
vocab.example: They had never ventured so far from home.

vocab.meaning: not wanting to do something, so you hesitate
vocab.example: Mia was reluctant to leave such a magical place.
Mia was so astonished that, for a long moment, she could not speak at all.

vocab.meaning: to love and care for something or someone very much
vocab.example: She will cherish it all her life.

vocab.meaning: able to recover quickly after something difficult
vocab.example: “We’re resilient, you and I. We fall down, and we get back up.”

quiz.q: What made the map begin to glow?
How did Mia find her way through the mist?
Who wrote the letter in the tin box?

outro.text: Thank you for joining Mia and Whiskers on their journey. If you could leave one treasure in a box for the next brave child, what would it be? Tell me in the comments, and I’ll see you in the next story.
